properties.name: Central Military Commission
properties.short_description: China's highest military command body, chaired by Xi Jinping, exercising leadership over all PLA services and arms.
properties.source_label: CRS / DoD China Military Power Report

properties.name: Eastern Theater Command HQ
properties.short_description: Joint command responsible for the Taiwan Strait and East China Sea theater, headquartered in the Nanjing area.

properties.name: Southern Theater Command HQ
properties.short_description: Joint command responsible for the South China Sea theater, headquartered in the Guangzhou area.

properties.name: PLA Navy Headquarters
properties.short_description: Headquarters of the PLA Navy, directing China's naval services and the three theater fleets.

properties.name: Southern Theater Navy / South Sea Fleet HQ
properties.short_description: Command overseeing naval forces in the South China Sea theater, based in the Zhanjiang area.

properties.name: Eastern Theater Navy / East Sea Fleet HQ
properties.short_description: Command overseeing naval forces facing the East China Sea and Taiwan Strait, based in the Ningbo area.

properties.name: Northern Theater Navy / North Sea Fleet HQ
properties.short_description: Command overseeing naval forces in the Yellow Sea and northern approaches, based in the Qingdao area.

properties.name: Yulin Naval Base (Hainan)
properties.short_description: Strategically significant naval base in the Sanya area of Hainan, publicly associated with China's ballistic-missile submarine force and South China Sea access.

properties.name: Dalian Shipyard (naval construction)
properties.short_description: Major shipyard in the Dalian area publicly associated with PLA Navy surface-fleet and aircraft-carrier construction.

properties.name: PLA Air Force Headquarters
properties.short_description: Headquarters of the PLA Air Force, directing China's air services across the five theater commands.

properties.name: Southern Theater Air Presence (Hainan area)
properties.short_description: Publicly documented PLA Air Force presence in the Hainan area supporting South China Sea theater operations.

properties.name: PLA Rocket Force Headquarters
properties.short_description: Headquarters of the PLA Rocket Force, which controls China's land-based conventional and nuclear missile forces.

properties.name: PLARF Base 61 (Huangshan)
properties.short_description: Operational Rocket Force base headquartered in the Huangshan area, publicly associated with the eastern region oriented toward the Taiwan Strait theater.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLARF Base 62 (Kunming)
properties.short_description: Operational Rocket Force base headquartered in the Kunming area, publicly associated with southern and southwestern coverage.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLARF Base 63 (Huaihua)
properties.short_description: Operational Rocket Force base headquartered in the Huaihua area, publicly associated with inland southern coverage.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLARF Base 64 (Lanzhou)
properties.short_description: Operational Rocket Force base headquartered in the Lanzhou area, publicly associated with northwest and north-central coverage.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLARF Base 65 (Shenyang)
properties.short_description: Operational Rocket Force base headquartered in the Shenyang area, publicly associated with eastern and northeastern coverage.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLARF Base 66 (Luoyang)
properties.short_description: Operational Rocket Force base headquartered in the Luoyang area, publicly associated with central-China coverage and reserve forces.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLARF Base 67 (Baoji — support)
properties.short_description: Rocket Force support base headquartered in the Baoji area, publicly associated with central storage and handling of nuclear warheads.
properties.source_label: Air University CASI / IISS Military Balance

properties.name: PLA Aerospace Force (ASF)
properties.short_description: Space-mission arm formed from the former Strategic Support Force Space Systems Department in the April 2024 reorganization; manages space launch, tracking, and space-domain operations; reports directly to the CMC.

properties.name: Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center (Base 20)
properties.short_description: Major inland spaceport in the Inner Mongolia/Gansu border area used for crewed missions and a range of satellite launches; a corps-grade ASF unit.

properties.name: Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center (Base 25)
properties.short_description: Spaceport in the Kelan County area of Shanxi used mainly for polar and sun-synchronous orbit launches; a corps-grade ASF unit.

properties.name: Xichang Satellite Launch Center (Base 27)
properties.short_description: Spaceport in the Xichang area of Sichuan, China's primary site for geostationary and BeiDou launches; also oversees the Wenchang coastal site.

properties.name: Wenchang Space Launch Site (Hainan)
properties.short_description: Coastal spaceport in the Wenchang area of Hainan used for heavy-lift rockets such as the Long March 5 and 7; associated with Base 27.

properties.name: Xi'an Satellite Control Center (Base 26)
properties.short_description: Primary telemetry, tracking, and control node in the Xi'an area coordinating China's satellite control network; a corps-grade ASF unit.

properties.name: PLA Cyberspace Force (CSF)
properties.short_description: Cyber-mission arm formed from the former Strategic Support Force Network Systems Department in the April 2024 reorganization; reports directly to the CMC.

properties.name: PLA Information Support Force (ISF)
properties.short_description: Information and communications-backbone arm established 19 April 2024 to support integrated joint operations; reports directly to the CMC.

properties.name: Technical Intelligence Lineage Node (Haidian, Beijing)
properties.short_description: Beijing/Haidian area historically associated with the PLA's strategic signals-intelligence organization (the former General Staff Third Department, '3PLA'), whose mission and structure passed through the Strategic Support Force to today's Cyberspace Force.

properties.name: CSF Cyberspace Operations Base
properties.short_description: Cyberspace Force organization publicly associated with oversight of the PRC's offensive cyber forces; part of the arm reconstituted directly under the CMC in April 2024.

properties.name: CSF Eastern Technical Reconnaissance Base (theater-level)
properties.short_description: One of five corps-grade Technical Reconnaissance Bases publicly described as aligning with China's military theaters; the eastern base is associated with the Taiwan/East China Sea theater. Location shown at theater level only.

properties.name: CSF Southern Technical Reconnaissance Base (theater-level)
properties.short_description: One of five corps-grade Technical Reconnaissance Bases publicly described as aligning with China's military theaters; the southern base is associated with the South China Sea theater. Location shown at theater level only.
